summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Admin Panel restructuring and User Account Settings features. All backend APIs (20/20 tests passed - 100%) and frontend UI tests passed. Admin Dashboard correctly shows Hardware, RTOS/Middleware, Software Components, and IDE Downloads sections without User Management. User Account Settings page fully functional with profile editing, password change, and account deletion.

Admin stats endpoint includes software_components and software_by_type breakdown
GET /api/software-components returns all software components
GET /api/software-components?component_type=SDK filters by type correctly
GET /api/component-types returns valid component types list
POST /api/admin/software-components creates new component (admin only)
PUT /api/admin/software-components/{id} updates component (admin only)
DELETE /api/admin/software-components/{id} deletes component (admin only)
Invalid component type returns 400 error
GET /api/ide-downloads returns all IDE downloads

PUT /api/admin/ide-downloads/{id} updates IDE download (admin only)
DELETE /api/admin/ide-downloads/{id} deletes IDE download (admin only)
GET /api/auth/me returns user profile

GET /api/account/projects/stats returns user project statistics
PUT /api/account/password changes password with correct current password
PUT /api/account/password rejects wrong current password (400)
DELETE /api/account deletes user account and all associated data
Login flow redirects to /builder after successful authentication
